name: Dumbbell Hammer Spider Curl
steps: Lie chest down against an incline bench with your arms hanging and your palms facing each other around the dumbbell handles.
Curl the dumbbells toward your shoulders without turning your palms.
Extend your elbows slowly to let the dumbbells hang again.
tips: Keep your elbows beneath your shoulders.
Keep your chest pressed to the pad and lower slowly without swinging the weights.
